author: Kushal
problem: A yarn dyer uses grams of dye for every batch_kg kilograms of wool. Return how many whole grams of dye (rounded down) are needed for wool_kg kilograms of wool.
bug_description: Divides before multiplying (grams // batch_kg * wool_kg), so the remainder of grams per kilogram is thrown away before scaling up.

comments.accurate: Returns the whole grams of dye for the wool, scaled from the recipe
comments.wrong_behavior: Works out the whole grams per kilogram of the recipe, then scales that to the wool
comments.wrong_location: Scaling formula checked; batch_kg may need to be at least 1 to avoid dividing by zero
